interview.name: Rey
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location haven’t been finalized yet.

reflections: Rey is acting as a coordinator for the repair drive, keeping both Oren and Ira informed as details come in.
Oren is willing to help but is currently reliant on Rey to direct the work and provide specifics.
Ira and Rey are aligned on staying in touch and comparing notes once more information is available.
Rey is a central coordinator who stays responsive, compares notes, and helps align the group on incomplete repair details.
Ira tends to ask for status updates and seems comfortable waiting until others have more information before acting.
Hana and Opal are organized collaborators who want clear first items and mapped drop-off spots before proceeding.
Rey is coordinating multiple repair-related threads and prefers to share information once it is sorted, which others accept.
The group works collaboratively by comparing notes and mapping details carefully, with Opal and Hana asking for specific follow-ups.
Faye is scheduling around family logistics, so timing updates matter for coordinating the repair drive.
Rey is coordinating a repair drive and wants to keep the plan organized before sharing it out.
Opal, Dane, Faye, and Vik are all offering practical help by tracking spots, timing, or repeating the plan.
The group is waiting on Rey to finalize the list and first fix, so Rey is the current bottleneck for progress.
Rey is coordinating logistics by keeping the list organized and sharing fixes as they become ready.
Dane, Pia, Vik, and Cleo are supportive collaborators who each take on tracking, timing, or comparison tasks to reduce confusion.
The group is focused on a community repair drive and depends on clear details like locations, contacts, and timing to move efficiently.

events.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, my memory’s a bit fuzzy. I’m happy to help, just point me to what needs doing.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’m mostly gathering a few things that need fixing, so I’ll point you to the first one when I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rey—just let me know when you’re ready and I’ll do my best to help out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the current plan for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the latest details yet, but I can check in and let you know. If you’ve heard anything, I’d be glad to compare notes.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I haven’t heard anything new either. Let’s compare notes once you check in.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’m still gathering a few things that need fixing, so I’ll point you to the first one once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — just send me the first item when you’re ready, and I’ll check the details before we pack anything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send over the first item once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m mainly trying to keep the drop-off spots organized and match each repair item to the right place. If you hear of any good spots, let me know and I’ll track them.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an ear out for good drop-off spots and let you know if I hear anything useful. If you’ve already narrowed down a few, I’m happy to compare notes.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: That’d be great, Rey — I’ve got a few possible spots, and I’d love to compare notes so I can keep everything mapped cleanly.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: I’m still gathering a few things that need fixing, but I’ll point you to the first one once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send me the final time when you have it, and I’ll fit the repair drive around school pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send you the final time as soon as I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the current plan for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Dane: I’m still waiting on the full list, but I can help keep track of the drop-off spots and where each repair item needs to go once we have it.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane — that’d help a lot. Once the list comes in, let’s compare notes on the spots and keep it organized.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: I’m still gathering a few things that need fixing, but I’ll point you to the first one once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — just send me the first one when you’re ready, and I’ll keep repeating the plan once the time’s locked in.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’m just sorting the list now, and I’ll send you the first fix as soon as it’s ready.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks — once I have the times, I can line everything up around the drop-off spot and pickup contact. That’ll make the repair drive much less stressful.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: What’s the main thing you need for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Mostly the drop-off spot, the pickup contact, and the times — then I can line everything up.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: That works for me — I’ll check the supplies we’ve got left and make a quick list for Sunday at the community center.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll do the same and compare notes so we don’t miss anything.
events.speaker: Cleo

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
